basic_info.description: 1619 Noe Street is a beautiful transformation, down-to-the-studs remodel of a Noe Valley Victorian home. Flooded with natural light, this lovely home offers a thoughtful & flexible floor plan, high ceilings, and timeless finishes. Upon entrance, your eye is drawn to floor to ceiling windows with a green backdrop, creating a warm environment for the rest of the home.  A spacious living room with skylights, easily connects to the heart of the home - a bright kitchen a and sunlit dining room with french doors to a deck overlooking the garden. Two comfortable bedrooms, a full bathroom, and coat/storage closet complete the main level. The lower level hosts an ample-sized primary bedroom with french doors to the garden and an en-suite bathroom with a double-vanity, spacious shower, and toilet room. Down the hall is a den/office with a half bathroom, a laundry room, and abundant storage space with two hall closets and a utility room with access to the front exterior.  A level, landscaped garden (accessed from both levels) offers tranquility with mature trees and a private escape. A wonderful location, one block to Sanchez Slow Street, two blocks to Upper Noe Rec Center, and easy access to both Noe Valley and Bernal Heights corridors.
